name: read_file_safe
description: A dynamic Python plugin tool to safely read file contents in chunks when standard cat/type fails due to buffer limits. Use this to read large files.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the file.

start_line.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed). Defaults to 1.

end_line.description: Line number to stop reading at (1-indexed, inclusive). Defaults to end of file.
